d: As the US midterm elections approach, candidates are making an unusual pitch to Indian-American voters. From trying their hand at making dosas in Texas to attending Diwali celebrations and visiting Hindu temples, politicians are turning to cultural outreach to connect with the community. Democrat James Talarico, who is challenging Republican Ken Paxton for a Senate seat in Texas, is among those making the effort. Senators and Republican lawmakers are also reaching out. With closely contested races in states such as Georgia and Michigan, Indian-American voters are emerging as a constituency…
